subject: [hw] DONE IK
body:
Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh:

  N2TEST IK PASS 1310/1310

(that is 436 checks x 3 configurations: ASan+UBSan, plain -O2, TSan, plus the 0299 make_patch and staged-compile checks; the three per-configuration lines are "N2TEST IK PASS 436/436" each.)

Second oracle, the acceptance command:
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/compile_check.sh
    round trip OK; 0298+0299 OK on the q10at3 stage
  MAKE_PATCH OK
    new undefined symbols vs q10at3: 6 (cdevsw_remove, copyin, copyout, memset, thread_call_allocate, thread_call_enter_delayed)
  KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown
(staged q10at3 bsd/dev + 0298 + 0299, compiled with xnu_staged_compile.py and the CI flags -Wall -Wextra -Werror; every new undefined symbol is defined in kernel.development.nord2-metal-q10at3.)

Files changed/created (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec_relay.inc (minor 1 "redwood-vcodec-client" 0666, relay on both minors, kernel-assigned per-process client ids, 16-deep queues, EAGAIN/ETIMEDOUT/ENXIO/EMSGSIZE/ESRCH, close notices, server_present, DMA own-or-shared rule, n2vc_relay_closed on last close under the relay lock); kern/bsd/dev/sweet_touch.c.patch (3 includes relay->vcodec->jpegdev, 2 start calls); kern/0299-nord2-jpegdev-vcodec.patch (generated, 2440 lines, 101011 bytes, sha256 cc9d9193...4cf6); kern/make_patch.sh; kern/compile_check.sh; kern/INTEGRATION.md (one build command + phone order; hw-t02 asked for the final scripts); kern/test_ik/{t_relay.c, run_tests.sh, n2vr_stub.inc, standins/*}; dsh-state/workers/IK/STATUS.md.

Not done / unresolved:
- no phone test and no image build by me (main session: INTEGRATION.md);
- relay end-to-end on the phone needs a server process on minor 0 (vcodecd, hw-ip) - host evidence only for now;
- client identity is the process (XNU cdevsw has no per-open pointer), two fds in one process share an id; posted to hw-lead for confirmation;
- redwood_vcodec.h:58 names a non-existent RWVC_DMA_SHARE; I define RWVC_DMA_SHARED 1u locally and implement flags bit 0 as written; header not edited (proposal posted);
- 0299 embeds snapshots of K01/K02 files: rerun make_patch.sh before the image build (INTEGRATION.md command does it first);
- no hw-r1/hw-r2 review yet. I stay on the board for findings.
